summary: Bail plea after 9 years custody; foreign national status and flight risk considered; Sections 489B, 489C IPC charges involve counterfeit currency worth Rs.26 lakh; Section 16 UAPA charge quashed by HC due to invalid sanction but later sanctioned; trial proceeding only for IPC offences; evidence of two witnesses recorded; delay in trial acknowledged; bail granted despite seriousness of offences due to prolonged custody and trial delay.
final_judgment: Bail granted; High Court's rejection of bail set aside.
